messages:
Marta - Procurement: SignalVec sent a renewal with an unexpected 'ingestion fee' line and a per-dimension multiplier. Need quick triage before PR. Quote in Drive: https://drive.google.com/signalvec-renewal. @Diego @Noor @Priya @Hana

Diego (Finance): Paste the fee lines please. We need 12mo TCO and any one-time charges called out.

Marta - Procurement: Quote excerpt:
```
Base usage: $0.000016/embed
Ingestion fee: $0.005 per vector for bulk imports >1M vectors
High-dim multiplier: vectors >1024 dims billed at 1.3x
Term: 12 months, NET30
```

Noor (ML Eng): We did a bulk import in Mar (~2.8M @1536d). That ingestion fee would be a big hit. Need meter spec: how ingestion is measured (per-vector, per-minute), and whether multiplier applies to streaming calls.

SignalVec Rep: Hi all ":wave:" The ingestion fee applies to sustained bulk imports that require offline ETL. It is priced per-vector currently. Multiplier only applied to batch imports by default; streaming calls are billed 1:1. We can waive the ingestion fee with a 12mo committed plan or offer a hybrid: small reserved pool + overlay w/o multiplier.

Priya (Legal): Contract ask: cap one-time fees, define ingestion calculation, include audit rights and dispute timeline. Also require data export/wipe on termination.

Hana (Security): For any on-prem or data transfer work, we need a clear list of access and telemetry. No agent should require SSH into our network.

Diego (Finance): Preferred ask: get a revised quote that (1) waives ingestion fee for renewal, (2) removes multiplier for streaming, (3) includes sample peak-month invoice, and (4) adds annual price cap.

Marta - Procurement: Agreed. @SignalVec Rep please send revised quote + sample invoice + meter-spec. @Procurement-Bot open PR when docs arrive and add approvers: Diego, Priya, Security.

Procurement-Bot: Created PR #604: "SignalVec ingestion fee & multiplier review". Link: https://procurement.internal/pr/604

SignalVec Rep: Will send revised package by EOD and include a peak-month invoice example and SLA appendix.

Marta - Procurement: Thanks — we'll triage once received. :thumbsup:
